title: Let My People Go
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’

title: Who Is the LORD?
text: Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go?

title: Three Days into the Wilderness
text: Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God …

title: Get Back to Your Labor
text: Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Get back to your labor!

title: No More Straw
text: You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks.

title: Gathering Stubble
text: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

title: The Same Quota
text: Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.

title: A Stench before Pharaoh
text: … for you have made us a stench before Pharaoh and his officials …

title: Why Have You Brought Trouble?
text: Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?

title: They Will Know
text: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD …

title: The Nile Turned to Blood
text: … all the water was turned to blood.

title: Frogs
text: The Nile will teem with frogs …

title: Gnats
text: All the dust of the earth turned into gnats throughout the land of Egypt.

title: Swarms of Flies
text: Thick swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace …

title: The Livestock Died
text: … but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.

title: Boils
text: … festering boils broke out on man and beast.

title: Hail
text: So the LORD rained down hail upon the land of Egypt.

title: Locusts
text: Never before had there been so many locusts, and never again will there be.

title: Total Darkness
text: … total darkness covered all the land of Egypt for three days.

title: Special Treatment for Goshen
text: But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen, where My people live …

title: About Midnight
text: About midnight I will go throughout Egypt …

title: A Distinction
text: Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

title: Pharaoh's Heart
text: … but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart so that he would not let the Israelites go out of his land.

title: The Finger of God
text: “This is the finger of God,” the magicians said to Pharaoh.

title: Slackers
text: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’

title: A Full Quota
text: You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.

title: Light in Their Dwellings
text: Yet all the Israelites had light in their dwellings.
